title: Upper Body Pillars
description: Explosive push (Hindu, archer push-ups) and a full back pull with 4 exercises each

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Step-ups
exercises.instructions: Step up and down alternating legs

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate rounding and arching your back, breathe

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
exercises.instructions: Hold a deep squat, back straight, elbows against the knees

exercises.name: Hindu push-ups
exercises.instructions: Diving motion: swoop down then rise back up in an arc

exercises.name: Archer push-ups
exercises.instructions: One arm extended to the side, lower toward the other hand

exercises.name: Explosive push-ups
exercises.instructions: Push hard enough for your hands to leave the floor

exercises.name: Incline push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands on an elevated surface, easier variation

exercises.name: Back extensions
exercises.instructions: Lying face down, lift your torso off the floor, squeeze shoulder blades

exercises.name: Scapular push-ups
exercises.instructions: In a plank, squeeze and spread shoulder blades without bending elbows

exercises.name: Prone Y raises
exercises.instructions: Face down, arms in a Y position, lift and hold 2s

exercises.name: Superman
exercises.instructions: Lying face down, lift arms and legs at the same time, hold 2s

exercises.name: Chest stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm against a wall at 90 degrees, rotate your body

exercises.name: Triceps stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm behind your head, pull the elbow with your other hand

exercises.name: Hip 90/90
exercises.instructions: Seated, legs at 90 degrees, pivot from side to side

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
